channel.title: Baseten Changelog
channel.description: The latest updates and improvements from Baseten

item.title: elephant-1 and mammoth-1 available on Baseten
item.description: elephant-1 and mammoth-1 are now available through Baseten Model APIs. Classify text, route requests, and score content against a rubric. Send one or more questions in a single request to get...

item.title: Beam-1.0 available on Baseten
item.description: Reflection's Beam is now available through Baseten Model APIs as reflection/Beam-1.0. It supports a 1M-token context window, tool calling, and always-on reasoning. Set reasoning_effort from minimal...

item.title: Muse Spark Open and Nemotron 3.5 Super VL available on Baseten
item.description: Meta Muse Spark Open and NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL are now available through Baseten Model APIs. Send requests through the OpenAI-compatible endpoint with your Baseten API key.

item.title: Egress restrictions
item.description: Baseten now supports restricting a deployment’s outbound network traffic to an allow list of IP ranges and domains. Add egress_restrictions under runtime in your Truss config to lock down a sensitive...

item.title: Rolling deployments enabled by default
item.description: Baseten enables rolling deployments by default for newly created model environments. Promotions replace replicas incrementally and shift traffic in steps. Existing environments keep their settings,...

item.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Fast available on Baseten
item.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Fast is now available through Baseten Model APIs. It serves the same 552B-parameter multimodal model as DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at full precision, on dedicated Fast capacity for...

item.title: Baseten CLI 1.1.0
item.description: You can now rename a model from the terminal with baseten model rename.. The model keeps its ID, endpoints, and deployments, so only the name in config.yaml needs updating.

item.title: Upcoming change to Baseten API key format
item.description: Starting Thursday, October 1 at 15:00 UTC, newly created Baseten API keys will add a b10_ prefix, making them easier to identify in code, logs, and secret scanners.

item.title: Web search with Baseten Hosted Tools
item.description: Baseten Hosted Tools now brings server-side web search to Model APIs through Baseten Grounded Inference. Models can search and fetch current web content through Exa, Keenable, Parallel, or You.com...

item.title: Baseten CLI 1.0.0
item.description: The Baseten CLI is now generally available. Version 1.0.0 marks the command surface as stable.

item.title: Model API Deprecation (GLM 4.7, Kimi K2.7, Kimi K2.6, Inkling, Inkling Small, DeepSeek v4 Pro)
item.description: GLM 4.7, Kimi K2.7, Kimi K2.6, Inkling, Inkling Small, and DeepSeek v4 Pro will be deprecated at 5pm PT September 25th.

item.title: OIDC and AWS AssumeRole for training jobs
item.description: Training jobs can now use OIDC or AWS AssumeRole during setup to pull private container images and download model weights or training data without storing long-lived cloud credentials in Baseten.
